name: terminal-pet
description: A hand-drawn pixel-art pet that lives in the terminal and reacts to what Claude is doing. Comes with /pixel-pet, a skill for drawing your own pets.

visible.title: Pet: show
visible.description: Show the pet. /pet alone toggles it.

pet.title: Pet: which pet
pet.description: The pet to show, by its key: shiro, or one you drew with /pixel-pet. /pet list shows them, /pet <name> switches.

placement.title: Pet: placement
placement.description: corner: a narrow pane beside the conversation, the pet standing in its bottom corner (it docks in the fullscreen layout; elsewhere it is a small block above the prompt). band: a row above the prompt.

side.title: Pet: side above the prompt
side.description: Where the pet stands in the row above the prompt (band placement).

size.title: Pet: size
size.description: auto takes the largest that fits. Every size steps down (big, small, head) when the room is short.

clothes.title: Pet: clothes
clothes.description: Dress the pet in its outfit, when it has one.

tricks.title: Pet: dagger tricks
tricks.description: When the pet plays with its dagger: toss and twirl while Claude works, a toss (and now and then a fumble) every 30 seconds while idle, both, or off. Off also narrows the side pane.

hideFrame.title: Pet: hide the side pane frame
hideFrame.description: Paint over the side pane's top and bottom edge, close mark and divider in the pane background, and ask for a pane just as wide as the pet (with room for the dagger while tricks are on).

background.title: Pet: side pane background
background.description: The colour that fills the side pane, as #rrggbb: your terminal's background, so the pane blends in. Empty keeps the pane's own grey.
